search_window.basis: Previous completed watch-ledger heartbeat read directly from GitHub ops/watch-ledger, used as exclusive start bound. Search retrieval includes older background candidates, but findings require newly verified qualifying events or material updates in the hourly window.

coverage_notes.purpose: Supplementary audited-miss recall only; production Food Line collection remains authoritative.
target_classes: Loss/closure/fire/disaster to a community's only, sole, last or full-service grocery store
Canceled or suspended emergency food distribution caused by storm, flooding, fire, outage or facility damage
Abrupt pantry/food-bank closure or major service-access reduction
New official SNAP/WIC/food-assistance interruption with immediate benefit-access consequences
coverage_notes.recency_filter: First eight searches used recency=2 days. Final four used date-specific text without a recency engine filter; all candidates were date-vetted against the hourly window.
search_queries: "only grocery store" closed fire flood "November 8" OR "November 9" 2026
"food distribution" canceled storm November 9 2026 food bank
SNAP benefits outage interrupted November 9 2026 state agency alert
WIC services interrupted closed November 9 2026 official
food pantry closure suspended today November 9 2026 United States emergency
grocery store fire "Nov 8, 2026" small town sole
food bank cancel distribution November 8 2026 flooding storm

reviewed_exclusions.reason: Important Eau Claire cancellations for the remainder of 2026, but the direct article was published November 3 and updated November 6, before this observation window. No verified new update.
November 6 Lowell recovery article identifies scheduled emergency distribution and previously closed hurricane resource centers, not new canceled food distributions in the observed interval.
Virginia DSS alerts show previously announced November 5/6 non-food-specific office closures ending November 9 at 08:00 and older notices; no new SNAP/WIC benefits interruption established.
November 9 Michigan mobile pantry distributions listed as scheduled, not canceled.
November 2025 SNAP funding disruption, a year outside the observation window.
September 2026 weather-related food bank closure, already historical.
September 2026 sole/full-service store destruction, historical and not a new November 9 development.

source_or_search_failures.note: Recurring inaccessible federal SNAP state directory; state-level pages and targeted searches remained accessible.
Arizona AHCCCS news index inaccessible; no evidence this is a SNAP/WIC outage. Alternative agency alerts and searches remained accessible.

coverage_notes.coverage_assessment: All 12 targeted searches returned results without tool errors. Six of eight selected direct-source pages were accessible. Search results were dominated by historical grocery losses, September storm-related distribution interruptions, November 2025 SNAP news, routine food distribution listings, and pre-window Eau Claire cancellation. No new qualifying disruption was verified since 02:45:46 PST. Two recurring source-access restrictions caused DEGRADED status but did not materially compromise this bounded supplementary review. Zero findings is not proof of nationwide absence.
coverage_notes.excluded_content: Donation drives, routine program promotion, resource guides, recipes, opinion, generic price/inflation stories, nonqualifying disasters, duplicates and out-of-window events.
coverage_notes.notification_assessment: Zero findings; two nonmaterial 403 source-access limitations, so no user notification under the stated criteria.
coverage_notes.controls: No approval, publication, schedule change, task disabling or production collector mutation.
